title: Sign of evacuation on standard Young tableaux
source_title: Some Remarks on Sign-Balanced and Maj-Balanced Posets
difficulty_reason: The proof must turn evacuation into a sequence of restricted promotions with successively frozen labels, compute each relative permutation from two cycles, and sum the principal-ideal chain parity. The cell-content reduction then expresses the resulting shape statistic using odd rows and odd columns.
statement_scope: Exact original sign of the relative permutation from T to evac(T). The paper writes a minus before half the odd-row minus odd-column count, and the exercise writes a plus. Those agree modulo 2. Proposition 3.1(d) and the separate enumerative part (b) are outside this target.

statement_spans.label: Proposition 3.1(a)–(c) and its evacuation parity consequence. The original Exercise 151(a) is the linked Stanley p59.

proof_spans.label: Lemma 2.1, author Figure 2 and complete Proposition 2.3 proof of the promotion parity accumulation.
Proof of Proposition 3.1 from its start through the first conclusion (b) and (c) have the same parity, before the domino discussion.

context_spans.label: Linear extension relative parity and the definition of promotion; first proof input.
Ordinary Young diagram poset, consistency, cell contents and odd-part counts.

source_caveats: The fixed p6 condensed indexing sentence writes n−i+1 for earlier removed elements. The author definition at p5 uses n−k+1 for step k and Figure 2 explicitly shows the distinct frozen values. The sum in p6 also prints ν(P) under a t index; Γ(P) is defined as the sum of ν(t) on p5. Raw pages remain unmodified.
